about.title: About 4 Ever Clear Pools
text: 4EverClear Pools (or 4EC for short) was founded in 2005 by Scott & Patti Jensen with the help of their entrepreneur daughter, Stacy Gauna Phelps. Scott Jensen, a chemical engineer by trade, enjoyed spending his free time relaxing by his backyard pool. He had worked in the chemical plants for 30+ years and knew retirement wasn’t that far away but he wanted a business or second career once he retired. After researching many different industries and businesses, they decided to start a unique pool service company specializing in the chemical balancing and treatment of residential swimming pools.

When it comes to providing you with superior customer service and quality work, we understand the commitment it takes. We understand pool ownership is a big investment, and we take pride in providing only the best care for your backyard oasis. Our customers experience a breath of fresh air with 4EverClear that sets us apart from the competition. We pride ourselves on consistent reliable weekly service and an organizational structure designed for efficiency and customer service. You can trust that we will be honest, provide quality work at an affordable price, and stand behind our work.

As a Christian owned company, we operate and run 4EC with the same faith, values, and ethics that guide our personal lives. Every employee is treated as a family member. Stacy tells each new hire – “We are here to create a win-win situation.” We understand that life/work balance, good health insurance, and strong living wages are important factors in creating a positive work environment where employees enjoy their job – and stick around! Our employees do a great job of upholding our very high level of standards.
